statute_interpretation.description: Given a fact pattern and legal question, identify and correctly apply the relevant Nigerian statute

citation_verification.description: Given a proposition attributed to a Nigerian case, verify whether the proposition accurately reflects the case's holding

customary_law.description: Reasoning under Yoruba, Igbo, and Hausa customary law

sharia_law.description: Muslim personal status law under Sharia in northern Nigeria

long_document.description: Ratio decidendi, obiter dicta, and clause-level analysis of judgments and contracts

data_sources: Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria 1999 (as amended)
annotator_notes: All tasks are in English. Statute interpretation tasks require applying statutory text to fact patterns. Citation verification tasks require knowledge of well-known Nigerian Supreme Court precedent. Incomplete or unverifiable citations should be flagged as 'NO' (proposition not supported by cited authority).
